      • FIResult

        public FIResult(List<FloatPoint> handMarks,
        float[][] frame,
        Integer[] mirrorConfig)
        Constructor that creates an FIResult from a list of handMarks. Sets the handMarked flag to true. This constructor is called from GetFrameCentroidsExecutor private handMark method, which is the alternate way to build a FIResult when FindAndIdentify fails.
        Parameters:
        handMarks - the list of coordinates to construct FIResult with
        frame - used for array initialization sizing only
        See Also:
        GetFrameCentroidsExecutor
